title: Undead Legions - A Recruits Texturepack
description: A Recruits Mod Texturepack that makes recruits look like various forms of undead.
body:
**NOTE: This texturepack only works for human variant recruits not villager variants.**

## Salutations!
Salutations my fellow Necromancers, Liches, Deathmages, and other forms of sentient undead! 

Ever wanted to command a legion of undead to conquer your enemies instead of relying upon weak living soldiers? Well this texturepack will change your recruits to look like various types of undead that you can command to conquer your worlds.

## Textures
All the textures and assets are my own and your free to use them in your own modpacks and videos. You are NOT allowed to repost this and take credit for them.

## Bugs and Suggestions
If you encounter any bugs or suggestions feel free to leave them in the comments.

## Future Road Map
- Shaders support
- Villager textures
- Updated textures
- More TBD!
